description: This file defines the main application model for an iOS app, managing connections, permissions, and interactions with device hardware and external services. It includes logic for handling commands for system features such as camera, notifications, location, social contacts, calendar, reminders, motion sensors, and screen recording. It also manages gateway connections and deep linking, as well as app lifecycle events like entering background or foreground.

classes.name: NotificationCallError
classes.description: Wraps errors that can occur during notification calls, marked as Sendable.

classes.name: GatewayRelayIdentityResponse
classes.description: Decodable structure representing a device ID and public key response from a relay.

classes.name: NotificationInvokeLatch
classes.description: Synchronization primitive for coordinating notification request responses, ensuring prompt return even if system prompts block.

classes.name: IOSDeepLinkAgentPolicy
classes.description: Enumeration of policies for deep link message length restrictions.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Main observable class managing app state, gateway sessions, permissions, hardware interaction, and command handling.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIAction
methods.description: Handles user actions from the app's canvas, sending agent requests based on actions.

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Adjusts app behavior based on scene lifecycle events (active, background).

methods.name: beginBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Starts a background task to allow time for network connections to stabilize after app backgrounding.

methods.name: endBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Ends the background connection grace period and releases resources.

methods.name: grantBackgroundReconnectLease
methods.description: Grants a lease duration during which reconnect attempts should be maintained.

methods.name: suppressBackgroundReconnect
methods.description: Suppresses automatic reconnects when in background and optionally disconnects.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously requests wake word triggers from the gateway, decoding and saving them, with error handling for unauthorized roles.

methods.name: isGatewayHealthMonitorDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the gateway health monitor is disabled.

methods.name: setGatewayHealthMonitorDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the gateway health monitor.

methods.name: sendVoiceTranscript
methods.description: Sends voice transcript text to the gateway after ensuring connectivity, encoding the payload as JSON.

methods.name: handleDeepLink
methods.description: Handles URL-based deep links, routing to specific handlers based on the route parsed.

methods.name: handleAgentDeepLink
methods.description: Processes agent deep links, including validation, rate-limiting prompts, connection checks, and submission.

methods.name: sendAgentRequest
methods.description: Encodes and sends an agent request payload to the node gateway.

methods.name: isGatewayConnected
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if the gateway is connected.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and updates the main session key if different from the current, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: color(fromHex:)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal color string into a SwiftUI Color object.

methods.name: approvePendingAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Confirms and submits a pending deep link prompt if gateway is connected.

methods.name: declinePendingAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Cancels a pending deep link prompt, logging the action and updating UI.

methods.name: presentAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Displays a deep link prompt and updates the timestamp.

methods.name: queueAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Queues a prompt with an initial delay, handling multiple queued prompts.

methods.name: deliverQueuedAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Delivers queued prompts respecting rate limits and waiting for existing prompts to resolve.

methods.name: submitAgentDeepLink
methods.description: Attempts to send the deep link request, handling success and failure with logs and UI updates.

methods.name: effectiveAgentDeepLinkForPrompt
methods.description: Produces a sanitized version of the deep link, stripping sensitive routing components.

methods.name: isUnattendedDeepLinkAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a deep link key permits unattended forwarding based on predefined keys.

methods.name: expectedDeepLinkKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates, caches, and returns the deep link security key.

methods.name: generateDeepLinkKey
methods.description: Creates a cryptographically secure random key encoded as a URL-safe base64 string.
